heading: INT. DEEP-SPACE COLONY SHIP - HYDROPONICS BAY - "NIGHT CYCLE"

units.text: INT. DEEP-SPACE COLONY SHIP - HYDROPONICS BAY - "NIGHT CYCLE"
A cathedral-sized chamber, its curved ceiling lined with violet grow-lights dimmed to a gentle dusk.
Terraces of lettuce, wheat and tomato step down to a central pool where a pale mist lingers.
The air is warm and wet, and smells faintly of basil.
Somewhere, water drips in a patient rhythm.
DR. SAOIRSE KELLEHER (50s, silver hair in a braid, lab coat over a sleeping tunic) walks the terrace alone, brushing leaves with her fingertips.
Below, at the pool, a young technician, MATEO ROJAS-ILLINGWORTH (20s, rolled sleeves, tool belt) refills a nutrient dispenser.
The ship's AI, ORCHARD, glows as a faint green node at the end of each terrace.
Mateo. Aren't you off shift?
units.name: SAOIRSE

units.text: Couldn't sleep, Doctor.
units.name: MATEO

units.text: Nor could I.
units.name: SAOIRSE

units.text: It's quiet down here.
units.name: MATEO

units.text: It always was, my first voyage.
units.name: SAOIRSE

units.text: He smiles.
She sits on the terrace steps.
The mist swirls.
All systems nominal. Crop yield at one hundred and four percent.
units.name: ORCHARD

units.text: Thank you, Orchard.
units.name: SAOIRSE

units.text: It's weird, isn't it? Everything's so perfect.
units.name: MATEO

units.text: Perfect is what we aimed for.
units.name: SAOIRSE

units.text: Silence.
The water drips.
Mateo stops, tilting his head, listening.
That's not the drip.
units.name: MATEO

units.text: What?
units.name: SAOIRSE

units.text: The drip's every four seconds. That's every three.
units.name: MATEO

units.text: Correction. Condensation cycle is irregular.
units.name: ORCHARD

units.text: Saoirse stands.
Her hand lingers on a tomato vine.
The leaf is faintly warm, like skin.
Orchard. Run a biological scan on Terrace Three.
units.name: SAOIRSE

units.text: Scanning.
units.name: ORCHARD

units.text: The green node flickers.
Along the terrace, every plant turns, slowly, toward the two humans.
The mist in the pool thickens into a shape that is almost, but not quite, a face.
Scan complete. You are not alone.
units.name: ORCHARD
